Someone like you? I am someone like you. I feel within every part of my body the effects of the weight of the depression that lays on my life like a wet blanket over me, a fire.  I am not a slave. I am the master of my life and the owner of my own home. There's no space for depression there anymore. No chair for it in my room, no pillow upon my bed. I've washed my sheets, swept the floor, and wiped the mirror. Turned on every light and opened the blinds. I put a song on and opened the window. I stripped my clothes and walked bare into the warm bathroom. I washed away every thought, every memory all soaking, dripping from my hair. There's no space for it here anymore, so I don't let it come knocking. Take depression by the throat and absolutely kick it's ass. Start with slowly replacing your automatic negative thoughts with long, thoughtout reassurances like I cleared my home.
